company.shortDescription: Govly is building a market network for government contracting, like AngelList for government procurement.
company.description:
Govly is building a market network for government contracting, like AngelList for government procurement. Govly connects OEMs, VARs, and prime contract holders in a single network, with real-time opportunities from non-public contract feeds and a suite of tools to streamline the bidding process from discovery to award.

Govly empowers businesses by tapping into government opportunities allowing them to monitor, curate, and analyze the federal procurement ecosystem and focus on the opportunities that give the best chance of success.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $9,500,000, or 72.52% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $14,755,576 to $41,000,000, a 2.78x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 41 (-2 over 90 days) and market heat at 58 (-4).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
